rules.title: Santa Ana annual maximum allowable rent increase
rules.requirement: A landlord may raise rent only once a year by up to the lesser of 3% of current rent or 80% of the CPI change. The current maximum is 2.87% for September 1, 2026 through August 31, 2027.
rules.key_value: lesser of 3% or 80% of CPI change; currently 2.87% (9/1/2026–8/31/2027)

coverage_conditions.summary: Rental units covered by the Santa Ana Rent Stabilization and Just Cause Eviction Ordinance; specific exemptions are not stated in this document.

rules.citation: Santa Ana Rent Stabilization and Just Cause Eviction Ordinance
rules.quoted_span: The increase cannot be more than 3% of your current rent or 80% of the Consumer Price Index (CPI) change, whichever is less.

rules.title: Santa Ana just cause eviction requirement
rules.requirement: A landlord must have a valid reason to evict a tenant, such as nonpayment of rent, breach of the lease, or the landlord's intent to move into the property.

coverage_conditions.summary: Rental units covered by the Santa Ana Rent Stabilization and Just Cause Eviction Ordinance; specific exemptions are not stated in this document.

rules.citation: Santa Ana Rent Stabilization and Just Cause Eviction Ordinance
rules.quoted_span: Your landlord must have a valid reason to evict you. This could be for not paying rent, breaking the lease, or if the landlord wants to move into the property themselves.

rules.title: Santa Ana relocation assistance for no-fault evictions
rules.requirement: If a landlord evicts a tenant for certain reasons, the landlord may have to help pay the tenant's moving costs.

coverage_conditions.summary: Tenants evicted for certain (no-fault) reasons under the Ordinance; the amount and qualifying reasons are not specified in this document.
coverage_conditions.other_conditions: Applies only to evictions for certain reasons not specified in this document.

rules.citation: Santa Ana Rent Stabilization and Just Cause Eviction Ordinance
rules.quoted_span: If your landlord evicts you for certain reasons, they might have to help pay for your moving costs.

rules.title: Santa Ana registration fee pass-through cap
rules.requirement: Landlords may, but are not required to, pass through a registration fee to tenants, charged per rental unit and capped at $50. A landlord who charges more than $50 must reimburse the tenant for the overpayment.

coverage_conditions.summary: Rental units subject to the registration fee under the Ordinance; charged per unit, not per tenant.
coverage_conditions.other_conditions: Fee is charged per rental unit regardless of the number of tenants.

rules.citation: Santa Ana Rent Stabilization and Just Cause Eviction Ordinance
rules.quoted_span: If a landlord charges a tenant a pass-through fee greater than $50, the landlord shall reimburse the tenant for the registration fee pass-through overpayment.
